column1: # M15 item 8 reflection audit, render host 2026-10-05 (tests/visual/reflection-audit.sh at 1280x800 and 1920x1080, test card; mirror = the picture with REFLECT minus without).
# expected: mirror when the package declares one and its shell is shown (no placement drops a DS or 3DS shell, M15 item 2); none for computed layouts.

# live: the path that hands the compositor its frame on the Deck; every path ends in semu_render_game_gl, which crops (N64) and extracts the reported content rect, so the mirror samples what the emulator presents there.
